assets.prompt: Generate an ENTIRELY NEW photograph with new composition, not an edit of any earlier consultation image. Image2 identifies male consultant03, short black hair, clean-shaven, charcoal suit and open-collar white shirt. Image3 identifies female consultant02, chestnut updo, navy suit and white blouse. Keep those EXACT two identities, natural attractive professional appearance. Include one distinct 48-year-old female Taiwanese landowner with curly shoulder-length black hair, thin round glasses, olive blouse, different face from all consultants. NEW camera angle: over the landowner's RIGHT shoulder. Landowner is in the LEFT foreground in three-quarter back/profile, facing the consultants across a narrow waist-height project counter. Male consultant is center-right, female consultant center-left, both standing UPRIGHT behind counter facing the landowner. This means both consultants' faces are close to frontal toward the camera but their eyes look at the visible landowner's face, distinctly LEFT OF THE CAMERA, not toward the lens. Camera is offset from their conversation axis. HEADS TURN WITH THE EYES: their noses and faces align directly toward the landowner; do NOT leave heads facing one way while pupils look sharply sideways. Both eyes of each consultant naturally fully OPEN, aligned pupils, normal sclera, no crossing, no wandering pupil, no exaggerated sideways glance, no downcast gaze, no tilted head. Male consultant calmly explains with relaxed natural mouth; female consultant listens to the landowner, neutral awake professional expression, no romantic smile between consultants. Landowner's face profile turned toward male consultant. Open project cost and funding comparison folder rests flat on counter, its pages oriented for the landowner to read, not held up toward camera. Consultants have relaxed natural hands resting separately on counter beside folder; no pointing, no touching face, no chin-rest, no hands near faces, no intertwined or overlapping hands. Modern spacious real working project office, cost schedule pinned in background with indistinct small writing, no decorative building model. Soft neutral daylight, realistic skin and proportions, dry floor. Medium-wide, preserve facial detail and hands, all three people within central 80 percent for website cropping. NO stiff team pose, floating papers, extra fingers, merged fingers, weird wrists, body/object intersections, closed eyes, sleepy eyelids, couple gaze, cinematic color grade, artificial glow, logo, watermark or overlaid text. Main requirement: anatomically natural faces and matching HEAD + EYE directions at eye-level, clear client-directed work interaction.
